shorts_extract.hook: Sally leaves her marble in a basket, Anne moves it to a box — and 3-year-olds swear Sally will look in the box.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Baron-Cohen, Leslie & Frith's 1985 London puppet stage + the age 3-to-4.5 developmental leap across 178 studies.
shorts_extract.twist: Modern scientific upgrades: Damian Milton's two-way 'Double Empathy Problem' and the adult 'Curse of Knowledge'.
